claims.statement: The Commission states that EUDR will apply from 30 December 2026 to large and medium operators and certain small operators, with other micro and small operators following in 2027.
The regulation requires relevant products to be deforestation-free, legally produced, and covered by a due diligence statement, supported by plot geolocation and retained supply-chain information.

contrary_evidence: The 2025 simplification amendments reduce duties for some downstream and small actors.
Certification and supply-chain platforms already possess relevant supplier relationships.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: a permissioned supplier-plot graph plus learned validation rules for recurring geospatial and quantity defects
fingerprint.customer: EU importers and first placers of cocoa, coffee, rubber, soy, cattle, palm, or wood products with fragmented suppliers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: commodity agents, certification consultants, freight forwarders, and vertical ERP connectors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: geospatial intake, lot genealogy, risk-workflow evidence, reference propagation, and Information System submission support
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: the operator pays for setup, platform access, and each lot statement or upstream-reference bundle
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a relevant lot needs traceable plot, legality, risk, quantity, and upstream-statement evidence before release

founder_fit: Excellent data-science and geospatial automation fit, low-camera and partner-led, with a narrow Polish importer wedge and capital-light validation.
risks: False geolocation or broken mass balance can create serious customer exposure.
Satellite checks must be framed as risk evidence, not a legal guarantee.
Product-scope and Information System changes require rapid updates.

structure.control_point: the negligible-risk lot lineage and due-diligence-statement reference required before market placement or export
structure.critical_dependency: accurate plot geolocation, chain-of-custody, and legality evidence supplied by producers and traders

thesis: A provenance clearinghouse can convert supplier plot files, legality documents, upstream references, and shipment quantities into auditable lot lineage and EUDR Information System submissions. It sells through commodity agents and food/wood ERP integrators, and compounds as the same permissioned plots and upstream statements recur across lots and downstream buyers.
title: EUDR Parcel Provenance Clearinghouse for Ingredient and Timber Importers
uncertainties: How much evidence reuse customers will legally and commercially permit.
Actual exception rates in the revised Information System.
